program.name: NJ FamilyCare Cover All Kids
program.description_short: Free or low-cost health coverage for New Jersey kids, whatever their immigration status
program.description:
Cover All Kids is part of NJ FamilyCare, New Jersey's public health insurance. It covers children no matter their immigration status.

Your child gets a health plan that pays for check-ups, doctor visits, dental and eye care, prescriptions, hospital care, and mental health care. Most families pay nothing, and some pay small co-pays at the doctor. The amount we show is our estimate of what a similar private health plan would cost your family for one child for a year. The real price depends on where you live and your child's age.

You don't need a Social Security number or immigration papers for your child. You'll be asked where you live and how much your family earns. You can also apply by phone at 1-800-701-0710 (TTY: 711), with free interpreters, or in person at your County Board of Social Services. Coverage has to be renewed once a year, so watch for mail from NJ FamilyCare and reply on time.

Select "Apply Online" to start your NJ FamilyCare application.
